text:
lee: Giving away an LG 34" ultrawide (29:9) and a small two-seater couch. Moving out of Bernal tomorrow, curb pickup only. Monitor is 2017 model, no dead pixels, VESA adapter included. Couch is a compact 63in fabric loveseat, one arm has a faint stain (photo in thread). Would rather they go together but will split if needed. Pickup window 5-7pm.

amy: Curious about the monitor stand height and whether it has USB-C. Also what floor is pickup on?

lee: Monitor is on a low riser stand (about 4in). No USB-C, DP+HDMI only. Pickup is 2nd floor walkup. I can help carry downstairs if you bring someone to load.

noah: Ill take the monitor if its still available. Can do 6pm pickup and have a hatchback. Happy to help with the couch too if someone wants it.

sara: Couch looks great for my studio. Can you confirm dimensions and whether the cushion covers are removable?

lee: Couch dims: 63in L x 33in D x 33in H. Cushion covers zip off but one zipper needs a new pull. Weight assembled ~70 lbs.

lee: Monitor specs: 
```
LG 34UM68
- 34" IPS 2560x1080
- 75Hz, FreeSync
- DP + 2x HDMI + audio out
- VESA 100x100 (adapter included)
```

amy: If @noah claims monitor, Ill take the couch. I can be there at 5:30 with a friend to carry.

noah: Confirmed for monitor at 6pm. DMing address. I can help carry couch if needed but amy has dibs.

deliver-bot: Reminder: Do not block sidewalk during pickup. Please bring moving straps for bulky items.

lee: Tentatively: monitor -> @noah (6pm), couch -> @amy (5:30). If anyone needs to switch times DM me. Pics uploaded in thread.

sara: DM sent with questions about the couch fabric. Thanks for posting!

lee: Thanks everyone :) Will post here if anything changes or if one item falls through.
